archimate:BusinessObject.name: data subject area
archimate:BusinessObject.documentation:
A data subject area is a high-level, logical grouping of data entities related to a specific business function or capability and are used to organize, govern and understand data assets. Data subject areas group related data entities to mirror real-world business concepts to improve data management and analytics. Subject areas may be hierarchical and contain other, smaller subject areas.
Key Aspects of Data Subject Areas 1. Business-Focused: They represent areas of organizational interest, such as Sales, HR, or Marketing. 2. Hierarchical: A broad subject area can contain sub-areas and entities.
